title: Finite projective modules lift over an etale neighbourhood of a closed subscheme
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ an ideal and $\overline P$ a finite projective $A/I$-module (a direct summand of a finite free $A/I$-module). Then there are a ring map $A\to A'$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}A'\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and the induced map $\alpha:A/I\to A'/IA'$ is an isomorphism, and a finite projective $A'$-module $P'$ together with an isomorphism of $A'/IA'$-modules $P'/IP'\cong\overline P\otimes_{A/I}A'/IA'$ (the tensor product formed via $\alpha$).

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M5 (lemma-lift-projective-module, line 2020) and its proof (projector lifted to A^n, characteristic polynomial, idempotent of B/IB lifted by Lemma lemma-lift-idempotent-upstairs)

proof.text: Use Mathlib Module.Finite.exists_comp_eq_id_of_projective to choose f:(A/I)^n → Pbar and g:Pbar → (A/I)^n with f∘g=id, f surjective, g injective. Put pbar=g∘f. Composition and f∘g=id prove pbar²=pbar, and surjectivity of f gives range(pbar)=range(g). LinearEquiv.ofInjective g identifies Pbar with range(pbar). This is the proved private helper finite_projective_projector.
Apply exists_etale_lift_finite_free_projector to pbar. Obtain A′, the étale map, α and its quotient compatibility, and an idempotent p′ on (A′)^n with the prescribed reduced matrix.

Take P′=range(p′). Apply idempotent_image_baseChange first to p′ with A′ → A′/IA′, and then to pbar with α. The first application supplies Module.Finite and Module.Projective for P′ and identifies (A′/IA′) ⊗_(A′) P′ with the range of the reduced p′. The second identifies (A′/IA′) ⊗_(A/I) range(pbar) with the range of the transported pbar. The matrix equality from the preceding step identifies these two ranges.

Use TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul to identify P′/IA′P′ with (A′/IA′) ⊗_(A′) P′. The private helper quotient_tensor_equiv verifies linearity over A′/IA′: lift a scalar to A′ and a vector to P′, then use the tensor balancing identity on 1⊗x. Tensor the equivalence Pbar ≃ range(pbar) from the first step, and compose the resulting four equivalences. This gives exactly the required quotient-module equivalence and finishes with the witnesses already chosen.

lean.statement: theorem lift_finite_projective_module_etale (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (Pbar : Type v) [AddCommGroup Pbar] [Module (A ⧸ I) Pbar] [Module.Finite (A ⧸ I) Pbar] [Module.Projective (A ⧸ I) Pbar] : ∃ (A' : CommRingCat.{u}) (g : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ A'), letI : Algebra A A' := g.hom.toAlgebra; Etale (Spec.map g) ∧ ∃ α : A ⧸ I ≃+* A' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A A'), (∀ a : A, α (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap A A' a)) ∧ ∃ (P' : Type u) (_ : AddCommGroup P') (_ : Module A' P'), Module.Finite A' P' ∧ Module.Projective A' P' ∧ letI : Algebra (A ⧸ I) (A' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A A')) := α.toRingHom.toAlgebra; Nonempty ((P' ⧸ (I.map (algebraMap A A') • (⊤ : Submodule A' P'))) ≃ₗ[ A' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A A')] ((A' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A A')) ⊗[A ⧸ I] Pbar))
